usedFor: Proposals and contract copies for ActiveCampaign deals are saved into a Dropbox folder whenever a deal is added or changes.

bestTemplate.name: “New Deal Added or Updated” in ActiveCampaign, then “Upload File to Dropbox”
bestTemplate.why: It saves a file from a public web link on each deal change, with add, replace or update.

watchOut: Edits fire “New Deal Added or Updated” again, so set “Upload File to Dropbox” to replace or update, not add.
